user.title: CamperMinder
user.description: The sensors of your levelling device are already filled in if the bundled firmware is running - please check them once. Then add your vehicle's dimensions. Everything can be changed later via "Configure".

data.departure_entities: Departure check: must not be open when driving off

data_description.motion_sensor: Announcements only happen while this is on — otherwise the vehicle speaks up at night when temperature drift crosses the threshold.
data_description.calibrate_button: Checked after calibrating: if the readings are not back at zero, Home Assistant tells you.
data_description.tolerance_cm: How much height difference still feels fine. 5 cm is a good starting point — tyre pressure and suspension absorb small differences anyway.
data_description.wedge_step: Height gained per step of your levelling ramps. At 0 the distance is announced in centimetres. Irrelevant for hydraulic or air systems.
data_description.notify_tts: For the Home Assistant app on Android: the text is spoken instead of shown. The announcement target itself is picked on the device page under "Announcement target".
data_description.location_source: A tablet or phone that stays in the vehicle (device_tracker of the Home Assistant app). Level has no GPS and takes its position from here. Also adds the “Set home here” button.
data_description.home_follow: Only for a Home Assistant inside the vehicle. When the vehicle has stood at a new place for five minutes after a drive, that place becomes the home location. Sunrise and sunset, weather and “home” depend on it. Without a “moving” sensor, GPS decides alone.
data_description.weather_entity: Optional. A weather entity with an hourly forecast, ideally Open-Meteo with the “Home” zone: it follows the home location and provides gusts. Adds the “Awning warning” sensor and its controls.
data_description.awning_entity: Optional. A sensor that is “on” or “open” while the awning is out. Warnings are then only given while it really is extended.
data_description.departure_entities: Optional. Doors, roof vents, step, locks – anything that must not be open when the vehicle starts rolling. The awning above is included automatically. As soon as “in motion” turns on while something here is still open, the “Departure warning” sensor turns on and an announcement is made.

error.device_unreachable: The levelling device is not reachable right now. Wheelbase, track width, tolerance and ramp step are stored on the device – please switch it on and save again.
error.location_source_missing: The home location can only follow the vehicle with a GPS source.

abort.already_configured: Levelling is already set up for this sensor.

init.title: CamperMinder
init.description: Change sensors and vehicle dimensions. The dimensions live on the levelling device and are saved there – this form always shows what currently applies.
